# Luggage

When you have a trip coming up, turn to our luggage collection to travel in style. From sleek leather bags to roomy suitcases on wheels, you'll find it all here, including styles with handy external pockets for those last-minute souvenirs.

Looking for carry-on luggage? Choose compact cases designed to fit in the overhead lockers. Expect practical functionality with front-slip and zipped pockets, making it easy to access essential items like boarding passes and passports. Look out for designs with zip panels which allow your luggage to expand, offering more space for longer trips. Handles at both the top and sides make these designs easy to lift and carry.

For those weekend trips, turn to one of these luggage bags. Duffels can be carried by flat top handles, or worn across the body using adjustable straps to keep your hands free. Crafted from resilient fabrics with waterproof finishes, these bags stand up to the elements in style. Inside multiple designs, expect to find spacious main compartments to help you stay organised. Take your pick from a selection of versatile colours, from deep navy to midnight black.
